reference_protocol.public_action: Reported concrete act of public government/court/regulator/central bank/statutory public institution; speech/statistics and private processes false; unresolved authority or actual performance null. reference_protocol.lane: Locked 55 classes. Alternatives listed only for coequal events or genuine title/ontology boundary ambiguity, before any outputs for this input are inspected.
reference_protocol.sector: Eleven coarse business-activity sectors. Direct issuer/operating industry only; exclude incidental financiers, publishers, stock-watch footers and speculative downstream effects. Commodity/macro prints alone empty. Specific affected activity may differ from whole-issuer catalog sector.
reference_protocol.novelty: Compared to 300 recoverable prior semantic runtime titles and this reserve's other titles by normalized title/URL and conservative token overlap. Does not certify exhaustive exclusion from older unrelated JEV experiments.
